page_title: ACM 3-3 GEN | AC Milan v Genoa 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Alessandro Prontera shows a yellow card to Johan Vasquez (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
90+3' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target.
90+3' AC Milan work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) gets on the scoresheet, but unfortunately for him it's an own goal.
87' The substitution is prepared. Christos Papadopoulos (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Caleb Ekuban.
86' Here comes a substitution. Alessandro Vogliacco is given a rest as he is replaced by Giorgio Cittadini (Genoa).
81' Here is a change. Samuel Chukwueze is going off and Stefano Pioli gives the last tactical orders to Malick Thiaw (AC Milan).
80' Today's match ends for Ismael Bennacer who will be replaced by Yacine Adli (AC Milan).
80' Stefano Pioli has decided to substitute Alessandro Florenzi and he is replaced by Pierre Kalulu (AC Milan).
76' Referee Alessandro Prontera points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The AC Milan players celebrate.
76' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The AC Milan players aren’t happy.
75' 3 - 2 Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the right post. What a wonderful strike!
74' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Aaron Martin is replaced by Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kevin Strootman (Genoa) is coming onto the pitch as Milan Badelj cannot continue after picking up an injury.

72' 2 - 2 Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 2:2.
72' AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
71' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
71' The total number of attempts is 20:4.
67' It will be a substitution. Noah Okafor (AC Milan) is ready to enter the pitch as Rafael Leao walks off.
67' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.

65' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot low into the middle of the goal, but Josep Martinez makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
64' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
59' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Josep Martinez intercepts the ball.
58' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well over the bar.
57' A spell of possession for Genoa in an attempt to control the game.
52' A goal, which was scored by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan), was disallowed due to offside.
48' 1 - 2 Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) leaps to connect with a lovely cross and scores with a header that bounces off the ground and goes inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
48' A great run by Morten Thorsby (Genoa) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
46' Referee Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AC Milan, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' 1 - 1 Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the right post.
44' Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle for a foul. AC Milan are awarded a free kick.
43' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
40' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Josep Martinez.
40' The referee points to the corner flag and AC Milan will take a corner.

39' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.

38' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) unleashes a promising shot towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Josep Martinez thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
35' Alessandro Prontera blows the whistle, Koni De Winter (Genoa) is penalised for a foul.
30' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' Total attempts – 9:1.
29' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Morten Frendrup (Genoa), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
26' None of the AC Milan players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
24' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post.
22' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
20' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
17' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is penalised for a foul. Alessandro Prontera had a clear view and blows his whistle.
16' The opposing goalkeeper had set up the wall well before the free kick was executed and Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) failed to send the ball over. Great defensive action!
14' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) squanders a golden opportunity after striking the ball onto the post of the goal!
13' AC Milan take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
12' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) latches on to a cross to head the ball wide of the net. A poor header.
11' Djed Spence (Genoa) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
10' AC Milan are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
5' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mateo Retegui (Genoa) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Marco Sportiello no chance!

5' Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle after Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Genoa are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alessandro Prontera.
